$$

$$

If $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]$ then what is the value of ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$" :question/worked-solution "We need to find ${x}_{1}$,  ${x}_{2}$, and ${x}_{3}$ such that  

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{b}_{1}+{x}_{2}{b}_{2}+{x}_{3}{b}_{3} & =x \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -3 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 0 \\ -6\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2 \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}6 \\ -2 \\ -6\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

From this, we get the system with the augmented matrix $M$, which we reduce using Gaussian elimination: 

$$
\begin{aligned}M= & [\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & 0 & 6 \\ -3 & 0 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & -6 & 0 & -6\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+3{R}_{1} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & 0 & 6 \\ 0 & 12 & 2 & 16 \\ 0 & -6 & 0 & -6\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+\frac{1}{2}{R}_{2} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & 0 & 6 \\ 0 & 12 & 2 & 16 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

  

The system is now 

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2}=6 \\ 12{x}_{2}+2{x}_{3}=16 \\ {x}_{3}=2.\end{aligned}
$$

From the third equation, we get ${x}_{3}=2.$ Substituting this into the second  equation yields

$$
12{x}_{2}+2(2)=16\,⟹\,{x}_{2}=1.
$$

 Finally,  by substituting ${x}_{2}=1$ into the first equation we obtain 

$$
{x}_{1}+4(1)=6\,⟹\,{x}_{1}=2.
$$

Therefore, $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ 2\end{aligned}].$

So, we have 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=2+1+2=5.
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard :question/answer-fields ["answer-field-3659e401-201b-5665-a817-8016820a5661"] :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id "answer-field-3659e401-201b-5665-a817-8016820a5661" :answer-field/id #uuid "3659e401-201b-5665-a817-8016820a5661" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/correct "answer-1298c82b-5f34-5b3d-9a2e-19a4db3c3122" :answer-field/choices ["answer-6f2c222c-23e3-58cc-87ec-9f7920cb1f7d" "answer-b92f0488-96a7-580a-9581-5603eab3169c" "answer-0e83f3a8-e73e-5dcd-ac90-e7fbd7a63237" "answer-1298c82b-5f34-5b3d-9a2e-19a4db3c3122" "answer-ef9d08f1-fc9e-5876-bc5a-62f5443e92fe"] :db/ensure [:answer-field/validate]} {:db/id "answer-6f2c222c-23e3-58cc-87ec-9f7920cb1f7d" :answer/id #uuid "6f2c222c-23e3-58cc-87ec-9f7920cb1f7d" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-5" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-b92f0488-96a7-580a-9581-5603eab3169c" :answer/id #uuid "b92f0488-96a7-580a-9581-5603eab3169c" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "3" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-0e83f3a8-e73e-5dcd-ac90-e7fbd7a63237" :answer/id #uuid "0e83f3a8-e73e-5dcd-ac90-e7fbd7a63237" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "4" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-1298c82b-5f34-5b3d-9a2e-19a4db3c3122" :answer/id #uuid "1298c82b-5f34-5b3d-9a2e-19a4db3c3122" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "5" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-ef9d08f1-fc9e-5876-bc5a-62f5443e92fe" :answer/id #uuid "ef9d08f1-fc9e-5876-bc5a-62f5443e92fe" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "x\notin \text{span}\{{b}_{1},{b}_{2}\}" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id 17592186345147 :question/problem "Find the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B=\{{b}_{1},{b}_{2}\},$ where

$$

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=2+5+(-2)=5.

$$
{\color{red}x_1} \mathbf{b}_1+{\color{blue}x_2} \mathbf{b}_2 = \mathbf{x}.
$$

We can write the vector $\mathbf x$ relative to the basis $\mathcal B$ using these coordinates, as follows:

![](images/05/0593ca6a838b66c4623e8749eb5236d6259b1f9bf36ed0d68b83c49781076341.svg)

\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{b}_{1}+{x}_{2}{b}_{2} & =x \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}8 \\ 4 \\ 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

$$
{\begin{aligned}2{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=8 \\ 2{x}_{2}=4\end{aligned}

![](images/82/82d4f494936d23e9b697aa4518edf68f7ea62e504d9d2576a6d13971acaf1c96.svg)
